svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print two frames 6 thick, 59.5 deep and 300 tall, lying flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 26 pockets 21.2 dia through, two rows at 25.5 and 47.5 in from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the back edge, 13 pockets per row at 22 pitch, the first 18 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print one plain (left) and one with a notch 6.5 deep from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back edge over the top 44.5 mm (right), which clears the latch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M2.5 heat-set inserts in the back edge of each, 40 and 220

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up from its bottom, on the frame's centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one frame 1 mm in from each end of the cells; cells pushed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in until 1 mm stands out for the nickel strip. The back edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rest on the tray back wall, held by two M2.5 countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws each from outside the tray.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cells sit square and do not turn by hand.
